title: The Seven Principles For Making Marriage Work

questions.q: What does Gottman call the mental representation of a partner's details?
questions.why: He describes a love map as storing personal information about the partner.

questions.q: How should couples respond to a partner's bid for attention?
questions.why: Gottman emphasizes turning toward bids to maintain a healthy marriage.

questions.q: Which gender, according to Gottman, benefits most from respecting the other's opinions?
questions.why: He notes stable marriages often have husbands who respect wives' opinions.

questions.q: What is the recommended approach to unsolvable problems in marriage?
questions.why: Gottman advises turning gridlock into dialogue rather than eradicating the problem.

questions.q: What does a gridlock indicate about a couple's hopes?
questions.why: He explains gridlock shows hopes that aren't being respected by the partner.
